title: build kaplan meier
summary: Six independent build jobs start together. By the observation cutoff, one completed at time 2; one still-running job was withdrawn from observation at time 3; two completed at time 4; and two still-running jobs were censored at time 5. The team must estimate the probability a comparable job remains unfinished past time 4 while handling the censored jobs correctly, rather than averaging only completed durations.
